newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Airlines forms marketing alliance.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Airlines forms marketing alliance.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp said Monday it will form an operational and marketing alliance with Garuda Indonesia Airlines that will enhance air service between the two nations.

A Memorandum of Understanding calls for the carriers to coordinate schedules and connections to link points in Indonesia and North America. Code-sharing and joint marketing programs are also part of the partnership, the first between a U.S. and Indonesian carrier, Northwest said.
Northwest serves a total of 14 cities in the Asia/Pacific region. Its stock was up 5/8 Monday at 38-3/8.
